failure_reasons.target_undercoverage: A substantial visible part of the intended target is missing.
failure_reasons.target_overcoverage: The mask extends materially beyond the intended target.
failure_reasons.background_leakage: Background pixels are materially included in the mask.
failure_reasons.non_target_object_inclusion: Pixels from another object are materially included.
failure_reasons.thin_structure_loss: A relevant thin target structure is omitted or broken.
failure_reasons.occlusion_boundary_error: The visible boundary at an occlusion is assigned incorrectly.
failure_reasons.excessive_ab_overlap: Object A and B masks overlap beyond the frozen acceptable rule.
failure_reasons.empty_mask: The generated mask has zero foreground pixels.
failure_reasons.near_empty_mask: The mask is nonempty but below the configured diagnostic area threshold.
failure_reasons.wrong_object: The mask selects a different object from the intended target.
failure_reasons.object_identity_inconsistent: The masked cutout no longer corresponds coherently to the intended object.
failure_reasons.severe_fragmentation: The target is split into implausible disconnected fragments.
failure_reasons.source_or_bbox_mismatch: The candidate, source image, object ID, or bounding box is mismatched.
failure_reasons.corrupt_or_unreadable_output: A required mask, cutout, overlay, or record cannot be read.
failure_reasons.reviewer_disagreement: Reviewers cannot resolve the mask decision without adjudication.
failure_reasons.other_mask_failure: A mask failure not covered above; a review note is mandatory.
